content: Hi! I am interested in contributing a formalization of the Master Theorem. Since CSLib lists it as a desired API in the CONTRIBUTING.md, but mathlib already has Mathlib.Computability.AkraBazzi and seems to be missing only the common specialization, I wanted to ask whether this would be better as a CSLib contribution or developed in mathlib first.

Since there is a mathlib todo note, it might be okay to start there and then let the reviewers and maintainers reach a consensus. But do please check that nobody is actively working on it already. There was someone asking about this recently.
